candidates.M2_ensemble: average of the per-model ranks of the one_class_svm and lightgbm scores; ranks taken against the sorted clean calibration scores of each model; weight w in {0.25,0.5,0.75} for lightgbm chosen on validation (lowest p90 delay among those with fahold FA <= 1.0 and no loss in detection greater than 0.01)
candidates.M3_temporal: lightgbm on the chosen features plus trailing 30 s summaries (mean, max, slope) of the six most important features by gain; implemented as a feature expansion, not a recurrent network, because no deep learning library is installed and the plan limits size by the Jetson budget
candidates.M4_autoencoder: run only if after M1-M3 the best validation consistent-takeover detection is below 0.85. sklearn MLPRegressor (32-8-32) trained on clean rows, score = reconstruction error
candidates.M5_hybrid: lightgbm with the EKF innovation features (this is the S_att_ekf feature set; reported under A2)

decision_logic.D1_cusum: on the model score z_t (decision_function): S_t = max(0, S_(t-1) + z_t - ref); alarm when S_t > h. ref in {p90, p99} of clean calibration active-row scores; h by bisection so clean calibration FA <= fa_per_hour_target (0.5/h)
decision_logic.D2_persistence: k in {3, 5, 10} consecutive rows above threshold, threshold re-calibrated for each k with the existing rule
decision_logic.D3_conformal: threshold = the ceil((n+1)(1-alpha))/n quantile of per-session persistence-filtered maximum scores on the clean calibration sessions (n = number of clean calibration sessions), alpha = 0.01 per 50 s of active session (about 0.72 alarms/h); implemented directly, MAPIE is not installed
decision_logic.choice: On validation, among decision rules that keep fahold FA <= 0.7/h and detection within 0.01 of the persistence k=5 baseline, take the lowest p90 delay. If none beats the baseline p90 by at least 0.5 s, keep persistence k=5.
